query:
WITH matched AS (
             SELECT id, email
             FROM users
             WHERE email IS NOT NULL
               AND lower(email) = lower($1)
             LIMIT 1
         )
         UPDATE users u
            SET platform_role = ($2::text)::platform_user_role,
                updated_at = now()
           FROM matched m
          WHERE u.id = m.id
         RETURNING u.id,
                   COALESCE(u.email, '') AS "email!",
                   u.platform_role::text AS "platform_role!"
